chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Outstanding engagements and his unorthodox fingering
summary: The Whiteman date was outstanding; he learned guitar alone and with wrong fingering, never using the little finger except for chords.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Do you remember any outstanding places that you played.

The Paul Whiteman thing was outstanding. The whole thing was outstanding. I had no time to time to enjoy, arrest or to do nothing. Even when I got home, I was just me & the guitar. But if I just had someone to show me to say "no, you could do it this way, or you could do it that way." Or any kind of help. But I just figured it out myself. And I would up when I did learn, I learned the wrong fingering. Unorthodox fingering, you know, not the correct way. That's why now when I play, I don't play with my little finger unless I'm playing chords. And you're supposed to use your little finger, along with everything else. I just learned, I did the best I could with the tools I had. As long that it came out pretty good, that's all that mattered.
